author: Bijan Mousavi

checks.command: npm run setup; npm run fixture-test; isolated npm run fixture-build -- node|netlify

title: Exclude run products from project typechecking
why: Saved inspection source under artifacts broke ordinary root Astro checks.
what: Exclude only run artifacts, retain inherited dist exclusion and guard this exact typecheck configuration delta.
how: Run original root check and both builds. Invalid application source must fail while artifact/dist probes stay excluded.
preserved: Published source, assets, commands, compiler options, adapters and inherited locks retain their identity. Application syntax remains checked.
risk: Broader exclusions could hide defects; the guard rejects compiler changes and application-source exclusions.
limitations: 118 tests and both builds pass. Root check passes in 7.11 seconds; invalid source returns exit 1. Pre-fix failure is retained. Committed-history replay and remote checks follow authoring.
rollback: Revert exclusion and guard/docs together in a reported change; preserve evidence and isolate checks until a verified replacement.
